Hosea Ballou: hymns in Tonic Solfa

Hosea Ballou (1771–1852) · Hymn writer

8 hymns on NoteFusion credit Hosea Ballou. Each is written out in Tonic Solfa under the words, with staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.

Words

    Behold, on Zion's heavenly shore,

    Doh is F4/4Tune: YORKSolfa PDF

    Dear Lord, behold thy servants, here,

    Doh is E4/4Tune: UXBRIDGESolfa PDF

  • From Worship, Now, Thy Church Dismiss

    From worship, now, thy church dismiss —

    Doh is Eb4/4Tune: MELCOMBESolfa PDF

  • In God's Eternity

    In God's eternity

    Doh is C3/4Tune: BOYLSTONSolfa PDF

  • Jesus His Empire Shall Extend

    Jesus his empire shall extend;

    Doh is F4/4Tune: YORKSolfa PDF

  • This Is the Fast the Lord Doth Choose

    This is the fast the Lord doth choose;

    Doh is E4/4Tune: UXBRIDGESolfa PDF

  • To Christ, the Son, the Father Spake

    To Christ, the Son, the Father spake:

    Doh is C4/4Tune: MELITASolfa PDF

  • When God Descends with Men to Dwell

    When God descends with men to dwell,
